column1: # shard-d5b — a quarter of shard-default5, split 2026-07-31.
# default5 carries the npm package `node`, whose generated `.bin/node` shim
# self-execs (BUG-N) and hangs every window that shells a bare `node`; as one
# 57-package shard it did not finish. `node` is isolated in shard-d5e so the
# other members are measurable. Run these INSTEAD of shard-default5, not beside it.
